heroSub: At Candy Hoover's cooker appliance factory in Eskisehir, production-line test data was automatically captured and matched to each product.
contextTitle: Digital and traceable test data management
contextP1: In this project implemented at Candy Hoover's cooker appliance factory in Eskisehir, test data generated on the production line was automatically collected and associated with each product.
contextP2: The goal was to manage test data in a digital and traceable manner.
problemTitle: Manual logging and limited product-level traceability
problemLede: Electrical and gas leakage test data was manually entered into Excel. This approach caused time loss and data entry errors, and made product-level traceability difficult.

problemList.text: Manual test data handling increased operational effort and slowed throughput.
Manual input increased the chance of quality and reliability issues.
Reliable product-to-result traceability was difficult without automatic matching.

solutionTitle: Automatic test data capture with serial-number association
solutionLede: By integrating test devices, electrical and gas leakage data was captured automatically. Product serial numbers were read at the station and test results were linked to the correct unit.

steps.title: Product Arrival at Station
steps.text: When a product reaches the station, its serial number is read via barcode scanner.

steps.title: Automatic Device Data Capture
steps.text: Results are collected automatically from electrical and gas leakage test devices.

steps.title: Serial Number Association
steps.text: Captured test outputs are linked to the scanned product serial number.

steps.title: Central Recording and Visibility
steps.text: Data is stored in OnSuite Trace and made available for monitoring and reporting.

techTitle: Test devices, barcode scanners, PLC, and OnSuite Trace

techGrid.title: Electrical and Gas Leakage Test Devices
techGrid.text: Shop-floor test equipment that automatically generates electrical and gas leakage results.

techGrid.title: Barcode Scanners
techGrid.text: Read product serial numbers at station entry to trigger accurate matching.

techGrid.title: PLC Integration
techGrid.text: Coordinates station workflow and data flow between devices and software.

techGrid.title: OnSuite Trace
techGrid.text: Central platform for end-to-end traceability and process management.

integrationTitle: Integrated test-station, Global MES, and traceability flow
integrationDesc: The system operates integrated with Candy Hoover's Global MES. Test data is matched with product serial numbers and centrally managed on OnSuite Trace.

integrationList.text: Test device outputs are linked to scanned serial numbers and stored in the correct product record.
Collected data is synchronized with Candy Hoover's Global MES for centralized visibility.

resultsTitle: Automated data capture and reliable product-level test traceability

resultsGrid.title: Manual Work Eliminated
resultsGrid.text: Manual Excel processing was removed and test data collection became automated.

resultsGrid.title: Reduced Errors and Time Loss
resultsGrid.text: Data entry errors and time loss caused by manual operations were significantly reduced.

resultsGrid.title: Improved Traceability and Reporting
resultsGrid.text: Automatic serial-number matching improved product-level traceability and reporting reliability.
